items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: I worked with John Handy, I worked with Vernon Alley

ctx.x: Is there, or has there been, any issue with racial tensions between musicians here or audiences or anything like that over the years?

Well I mean I think it exists everywhere to a subtle degree. But I think it’s easier here than it is in a lot of places as far as musicians working with each other — black musicians and white musicians working together. It’s not an issue, to tell the truth, it’s just not. There are so-called cliques everywhere, people that have people they like to play with, and that exists here just like it does everywhere, and sometimes it seems to be an exclusive black clique or an exclusive white clique. But I don’t think…
Is there an Asian influence in the music here?
